3. The loaded rollback mechanism
The outer release interfaces

Each cartridge connects through two profiled 7075-T6 aluminium wafers. Each wafer has:

Feature	Selected dimension
Thickness	3.5 mm
Outer square	40 mm
Inner square island	24 mm
Four connecting arms	8 mm wide × 5 mm free length
Removed slug per arm	2 × 8 × 3.5 mm
Wafers per cartridge	2
Punches for complete cartridge isolation	8

The cartridge occupies stations 140–240 mm along a member, with a 25 mm permanent halfwidth. The active cutter nose uses a 30 mm halfwidth.

The sheet grade is obtainable, but its finished allowable strength cannot be inferred from the alloy name. The model uses thickness-dependent material information as a starting point and requires purchased-lot certification, profile inspection, notch qualification and cutting coupons. Kaiser’s published properties are useful evidence about the stock, not certification of the new joint. 
online.kaiseraluminum.com

A real cutting-force return path

The selected hydraulic core is the Klauke PK60UNV, catalogued at 60 kN, 700 bar, 42 mm stroke, 350 mm length and 2.4 kg. Its existing specification does not qualify the custom die or loaded structural application. 
Klauke

The introduced cutting-force allowance is 37.07 kN. At 500 bar, the core’s inferred force is 42.86 kN.

The cutting reaction does not pass through a long unsupported fork. Four axial return ties around each wafer close force through a rear die carrier and rear head crosshead. Four ties are needed because the four punch locations produce eccentricity in two directions.

The local screen gives:

Maximum introduced hydraulic force: 44.14 kN.
Largest return-tie force: 19.46 kN.
Compression ram: 18 mm diameter, 310 mm long.
Scalar pinned Euler factor for that ram: 2.35.
Predicted ram shortening: 0.274 mm.

That shortening makes a local punch-to-die displacement sensor necessary. Cylinder travel alone is not a cut receipt.

The selected head budget is 38.5 kg. With an 8 kg cradle and the heaviest 4.428 kg bar, the carried package is 50.928 kg. A 75 kg payload rating is required, together with separately specified wrist moment, stiffness and stopping performance.
